description: This method retrieves the call limit and utilization data for an application user. The call-limit data is returned for all RESTful APIs and the legacy Trading API that limit calls on a per-user basis. By default, this method returns utilization data for all RESTful APIs resources and the legacy Trading API calls that limit request access by user. Use the api_name and api_context query parameters to filter the response to only the desired APIs.

parameters.name: api_context
parameters.description: This optional query parameter filters the result to include only the specified API context. Valid values: buy, sell, commerce, developer, tradingapi

parameters.name: api_name
parameters.description: This optional query parameter filters the result to include only the APIs specified. Example values: browse, inventory, taxonomy, tradingapi
